title: Thanks for the Memory, after Rod Stewart

details.title: Thanks for the Memory
details.lead: Rod Stewart's sung line, played straight on the trumpet. In his key, A, an octave up it would climb to B5, so it is in F, a third lower: concert A3 to G5 (written B3 to A5).
facts: Thanks for the Memory, as Rod Stewart sings it on the recording you sent
Rod's voice, read note by note and straightened
F concert, G for the trumpet
The song as Rod sings it, with rests where the band plays alone
